RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men. Because the hiring decision was made between male applicants, an all-male panel provides no basis for a claim of sex discrimination; sex almost certainly played no role in choosing him over you. While the panel composition reflects industry demographics rather than balanced representation, it did not disadvantage you on the basis of sex. 

Raising the panel's gender makeup would appear unfounded and damage your professional credibility. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback. The hiring decision likely hinged on commercial factors and soft skills—highlighted by the emphasis on client relationships—rather than years of technical experience alone.
